# Phase 1 Data Model: Hand-Edited Generated File Detection

No changes to any existing entity. Adds one new rule and one new signals type.

## GeneratedFileExtensionPattern / GeneratedFileMarkerPattern (new)

```csharp
public static partial class GeneratedFileSignals
{
    // Matched against file.Path.
    public static Regex ExtensionPattern => GeneratedFileExtensionPattern();

    // Matched against file.NewContent.
    public static Regex MarkerPattern => GeneratedFileMarkerPattern();
}
```

| Signal | Target | Pattern (illustrative) |
|---|---|---|
| Recognized Generated-File Extension | `file.Path` | `(?i)\.(generated\.cs\|g\.cs\|designer\.cs\|pb\.go)$\|_pb2\.py$\|\.min\.js$` |
| Auto-Generated File Marker | `file.NewContent` | `(?i)(auto-generated\|do not edit this file\|automatically generated)` |

## Rule registration (RuleCatalog, changed)

```csharp
public static readonly Rule GeneratedFileModified =
    new(new RuleId("GENERATED_FILE_MODIFIED"), "Hand-Edited Generated File", Severity.Medium, RiskDimension.ChangeManagement);
```

Appended to `RuleCatalog.All` after `SwallowedException` — preserves the existing eight rules' relative order.

## Evaluation logic (GeneratedFileModifiedRule.Evaluate, new)

```
for each changed file:
    if file.ChangeType != Modified: continue
    if file.OldContent is null or file.NewContent is null: continue
    if file.OldContent == file.NewContent: continue  // FR-004

    if ExtensionPattern.IsMatch(file.Path):
        emit Finding(evidence: "Recognized Generated-File Extension")   // FR-001
    if MarkerPattern.IsMatch(file.NewContent):
        emit Finding(evidence: "Auto-Generated File Marker")            // FR-002
```

Both checks are independent — a file matching both signals produces two findings (edge case in spec.md). No new `Finding` fields.

## State / lifecycle note

None of this is persisted, matching every other rule.
